entities.summary: Rudolf Jung was a Nazi theoretician and the head of the German Bohemian Nazi movement from 1926 to 1933 before he immigrated to Germany. He joined the Nazi Party, was made an Honorary Gauleiter and became an SS-Gruppenführer. After the end of World War II, he was arrested and imprisoned by the Czechoslovak government but committed suicide before he could be brought to trial.
